cards.card_text: Nobody has EVER had to persuade me to eat, friend, I'm already holding the plate.
cards.verse_text: One day Elisha went to Shunem, and a prominent woman who lived there persuaded him to have a meal.

cards.card_text: Next, Solomon says through patience a ruler can be persuaded.
cards.verse_text: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
cards.snippet: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.

cards.card_text: Abraham says that if someone rises from the dead, that will finally persuade the rich man's brothers.
cards.verse_text: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
cards.snippet: …do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”

cards.card_text: True or false: after Paul's three Sabbaths in the synagogue, none of the Jews in Thessalonica are persuaded.
cards.verse_text: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few leading women.

cards.card_text: But every Sabbath, he's in the synagogue, reasoning and trying to persuade.
cards.verse_text: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks alike.
cards.snippet: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks alike.

cards.card_text: Demetrius tells the craftsmen that one man has persuaded a great number of people to turn away.
cards.verse_text: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, this Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away.
cards.snippet: …Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, this Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away.

cards.verse_text: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”
cards.snippet: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”

cards.card_text: What was Abraham fully persuaded of?
cards.verse_text: being fully persuaded that God was able to do what He had promised.

cards.card_text: Then Paul says, “I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself.” But he's got a twist for the person who sees it differently.
